verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance's Scribe Agent joins incident calls and transcribes them in real time, recording key decisions, action items and events, which covers the scribed call notes. Advance also documents generative AI that summarizes key information about an incident, which covers live summaries. No evidence shows AI-drafted stakeholder or status updates; Status Pages document real-time communication but not AI drafting. missing for 10: AI-drafted incident or status updates, in-depth docs on live summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing

citations.quote: Transcribe incident meetings in real time to enhance incident summaries and post-incident reviews
Schedule a Scribe Agent to join incident calls and record key decisions, action items, and events once a conference bridge is available.
generative AI for summarizing key information about an incident
